glasshounds.name: Glasshounds
glasshounds.blurb: Car thieves and fixers out of Ashgrove. If it has wheels and a lock, they have opinions about it.

kurogane.name: Kurogane
kurogane.blurb: Corporate security syndicate that owns the Glass Quarter's towers and most of its laws.

velvet_choir.name: Velvet Choir
velvet_choir.blurb: They run every club, stage and back room in Lantern Row, and they never forget a favour.

rustmouth.name: Rustmouth
rustmouth.blurb: Dock scrappers and smugglers. Anything that comes off a ship in the Saltworks passes through their hands.

null_saints.name: Null Saints
null_saints.blurb: Hackers under the elevated rail. They trade in secrets, and they can make your TRACE vanish.
